description: Current USD prices of up to 30 tokens, with market cap, 24h volume and 24h change. Name each token as coingecko:<id> (coingecko:bitcoin), <chain>:<contract address> (ethereum:0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, solana:EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, base:0x...) or a bare CoinGecko id. Tokens without a price are listed in not_found; vault, LP and other tokens without a CoinGecko coin have a price but no market cap or volume. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tokens.description: Comma-separated tokens: coingecko:<id>, <chain>:<address> or a CoinGecko id.
